title: Australian Fish Bake
description: A simple and flavorful fish bake recipe from Australia, perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets
ingredients.notes: White fish like cod or snapper works well

ingredients.name: Like
ingredients.notes: Australian like is similar to soy sauce

ingredients.name: Bake
ingredients.notes: Australian bake is similar to breadcrumbs

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place fish fillets on the baking sheet.
Drizzle lemon juice over the fish.
Drizzle melted jelly over the fish.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Note: Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the fish.
